name: first-pass-docs
task:
Mark nim_first_pass_review as a low-yield extra in three files. Change nothing else.

1. GEMINI.md, in the agent-mode table (header `| Task | Use |`, the one that lists `nim_scout`): delete this row:
| First-pass review of a diff, with surrounding code | `nim_first_pass_review` (`/castor:first-pass`); pass `rev_range` or `diff_file`, never paste the diff |
Then, after the blank line that follows that table and before the paragraph that starts "Keep the judgment calls", insert this paragraph followed by one blank line:
**`nim_first_pass_review` (`/castor:first-pass`) is weak; don't build on it.**
In a five-review pilot on a Unity project (2026-11-02), 5 of its 25 leads held
up, all of them repeats of what the Claude review found, 12 were wrong, and it
caught none of the three known findings (it called one real bug correct). Use
it at most as an occasional extra on a small diff, never as a step a review or
pipeline waits on, and never in place of reading the diff yourself.

2. commands/castor/first-pass.md: after its last line, add a blank line and then this paragraph as one line:
Expect a low hit rate. In a five-review pilot on a Unity project, about 1 lead in 5 held up, all repeats of what the Claude review found, and it missed every known real finding. Say so when you report its results, and don't make it a step that other work waits on.

3. server.py, in the nim_first_pass_review docstring: after the line `    over about 1,500 lines are refused; review those in parts.` and the blank line below it, insert these three lines followed by one blank line, so they sit just before `    Args:`:
    Expect a low hit rate: in a five-review pilot about 1 lead in 5 held
    up and it missed every known real finding. Use it as an occasional
    extra, never as a step a review or pipeline waits on.
